title_block.title: Radxa CM5 ProComm Carrier - Thermal and GPIO Control

comment.value: EMC2305 controls CPU, modem, intake, and exhaust fans independently
PWM pull-ups provide full-speed hardware fallback if the controller or firmware fails
TMP117 sensors monitor CM5, modem, and board/power zones at 0x48/0x49/0x4A
TCA9535 0x20 captures source, fan, temperature, and power-monitor alerts
Two 12 V diffused warm-white panel lamps use an independent latching capacitive touch switch
